# Set A — original timed practice,20marks
Suggested50minutes:5reading,40working,5checking. Short questions8marks (~16working minutes), extended12marks (~24). This40/60 mark split is a classroom design choice; it is not a reproduction of SCSA's raw marks, full-paper timing or question count. First attempt on paper without answers/code execution; teacher adapts access arrangements. Formative only, no new weighted task.
Use the separate source booklet for all facts.
A1 (4): Trace a dictionary accumulator over supplied Python rows. State final mapping(1), show totals after each row(1), write a safe update for first/repeated keys(1), and state empty-input result with reason(1).
A2 (4): Write SQLite SQL returning ALL resources and total loan count, ordered ResourceID. Criteria: correct LEFTJOIN/link(1), non-null child count(1), grouping/alias/order(1), predicted ordered counts including zero resources(1).
A3 (6): Allocate the two subnets; for each give prefix,network,usable range,broadcast,gateway(2 total,1 per complete subnet). Explain first-hop MAC versus remote IP roles(2). Analyse hostname failure: plausible cause plus limitation(1), specific next check with distinguishing observation(1).
A4 (6): Analyse the supplied export case. Distinguish observation from identity/disclosure inference(1), justified server-side authorisation(1), positive/negative test pair(1), simplified TLS1.3 key roles and record protection(1), relevant APP11 security requirement(1), and missing federal breach-eligibility facts/prompt assessment rather than a30day notification delay(1). Apply facts, not just labels; accept defensible alternatives.
After attempt record start/finish, incomplete parts, uncertainty and two causes. Do not count rewritten answers as independent retries.
